summary: An unregistered tower in Colorado's Wet Mountains, mapped only as a bare OpenStreetMap point with no match in the national lookout registers or Forest Service records.
notes_for_editor: Coordinates (38.040996, -105.012697, elev ~2252m per OSM) fall in the Wet Mountains near Greenhorn Mountain/St Charles Peak/Lake Isabel, San Isabel National Forest area, but no cached or web source ties a named lookout to that exact point. Checked every cached NHLR and FFLOS Colorado entry's coordinates (both index pages) and none are within a reasonable distance of this node. Three WebSearch queries (generic coordinate/region search, San Isabel NF fire tower history, named Wet Mountains peaks) turned up nothing specific to this structure. Possible the OSM 'Fire Tower' label is generic (e.g. a different kind of tower, or a genuinely obscure/undocumented lookout) rather than a proper name — worth a human look if better aerial/historic-map sources become available.
